exp-e417da8c9ffa.approach: Preserve enlarged Audiveris melody and add an independent image-derived chord recognition pipeline using enlarged upper-staff crops, Tesseract, and constrained chord-symbol parsing.
exp-e417da8c9ffa.objective: On the seven first-per-song pilot images, recover missing chord symbols without changing baseline melody. Inspect images and OCR bounding boxes, normalize root, quality, extensions and slash bass, and emit parseable editable kern with a harmony spine. Retain existing baseline chords when image evidence does not support replacement. Estimate chord onset from horizontal alignment with notation and explicitly mark uncertain timing in a separate audit artifact. Use available packages only; request_environment if a required dependency is missing.
exp-e417da8c9ffa.success_criteria: Deliver sealed predictions for all seven pilot images, parse-validation results, and a per-image chord provenance table with crop coordinates, raw OCR, normalized symbols and timing uncertainty. Verify melody event sequences remain identical to the supplied baseline wherever parseable; report any baseline parse failure separately without inventing melody. Protected evaluation must compare chord error and melody error with enlarged Audiveris on the same seven images. Include a transposition round-trip check for melody and chord root/bass, identified as structural validation rather than measured musical accuracy.
